text:
rotator-bot: alert: increased tls.handshake_failures in eu-west-1 & ap-southeast-1 since 2024-06-11T02:10Z. rate ~5%.
Aisha: seeing 502s from inference-edge and api-gateway. Any rotator activity?
Liam: rotator executed scheduled intermediate rotation at 02:00. Keystore reports KMS Decrypt AccessDenied for alias/rotator-eu:v2.
Riley: log excerpt: 
[2024-06-11T02:00:07Z] rotator: INFO promote intermediate -> primary
[2024-06-11T02:00:12Z] rotator: ERROR kms:Decrypt AccessDenied for key/alias/rotator-eu:v2
[2024-06-11T02:00:20Z] proxy: WARN tls: handshake failed: missing_private_key

Sam: AccessDenied means rotator couldn't unwrap the private key material. That produces a cert with missing chain or broken key usage -> handshake errors. Why would IAM deny at rotation?
Aisha: We recently applied the cross-region policy template for infra-iam. I suspect the policy omitted kms:Decrypt for the rotator principal in eu and ap.
Liam: mitigation steps proposed:
1) Roll back to last_good cert on gateways in affected regions (Aisha).
2) Re-add kms:Decrypt to rotator role for affected key ARNs and run a simulated IAM check before next rotation (Sam).
3) Emit structured audit events for KMS Unwrap failures and Rotator publish events (Riley).
4) Disable TLS session resumption short-term to reduce resume-related mismatch (ops decision).

Aisha: I can push previous cert from backups: s3://cert-backups/eu/20240610-prev.pem and rotate pods gradually. Will stage to 2 pods then rollout.
Sam: IAM snippet to add: {
  "Effect":"Allow",
  "Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:DescribeKey"],
  "Resource":["arn:aws:kms:eu-west-1:123456789012:key/*","arn:aws:kms:ap-southeast-1:123456789012:key/*"]
}
Sam: will scope to exact ARNs in PR and add condition for the rotator service principal.
Riley: audit: include fields: event_type=KMS_UNWRAP_FAIL, region, key_alias, rotator_run_id, pod, host. Ship to splunk index tls-errors.
Liam: after rollback handshake error rate dropped from 5% -> 0.8% in 2 minutes. Good.
Aisha: proceeding with rollback now.
Sam: follow-ups: run account-wide IAM drift scan (iam:simulatePrincipalPolicy) for rotator roles; add integration test in rotator CI that verifies kms:Decrypt on target ARNs; update runbook with unwrap-check precondition.
Riley: I'll add the audit events and a dashboard tile for unwrap_fail_count.
Liam: creating incident ticket SEC-20240611-01 and will move ongoing coordination there.
Aisha: closing this thread and continuing in #incidents/SEC-20240611-01.
